basic.name: System Warning
basic.description_template: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Silver Wolf's ATK to one enemy.

skill.name: Allow Changes?
skill.description_template: There is a {{weakness_chance}}% base chance to add 1 Weakness of an on-field ally's Type to one enemy, prioritizing the Type of the first ally in the lineup, and reducing the enemy's RES to that Weakness Type by 20% for 3 turns. There is also a 100% base chance to reduce the target's All-Type RES by {{all_res_down}}% for 2 turns. Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Silver Wolf's ATK to the target.

ultimate.name: User Banned
ultimate.description_template: There is a {{base_chance}}% base chance to reduce all enemies' DEF by {{def_down}}% for 3 turns. At the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies.

talent.name: Awaiting System Response...
talent.description_template: Silver Wolf can create three types of Bugs: reduce ATK by {{atk_down}}%, reduce DEF by {{def_down}}%, and reduce SPD by {{spd_down}}%. After every attack launched by Silver Wolf, she has a {{bug_chance}}% base chance to implant 1 random Bug that lasts for 3 turns. When an enemy is defeated, the Weakness Silver Wolf implanted on it transfers to another surviving enemy that does not already have an implanted Weakness, prioritizing Elite targets and above.

technique.name: Force Quit Program
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Quantum DMG equal to 80% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies and reduces Toughness regardless of Weakness Type. Enemies whose Weakness is Broken this way trigger the Quantum Weakness Break effect.

2.name: Generate
2.description: Extends Bug duration by 1 turn. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, Silver Wolf has a 100% base chance to implant a random Bug in that enemy.

4.name: Inject
4.description: Immediately regenerates 20 Energy at the start of battle. Silver Wolf also regenerates 5 Energy at the start of each of her turns.

6.name: Side Note
6.description: For every 10% Effect Hit Rate Silver Wolf has, increases her ATK by 10%, up to a maximum increase of 50%.

eidolons.name: Social Engineering
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, Silver Wolf regenerates 7 Energy for every debuff on the target, up to 5 times per use of her Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Zombie Network
eidolons.description: When an enemy enters battle, increases its DMG received by 20%. When an ally attacks that enemy, Silver Wolf has a 100% base chance to implant 1 random Bug.

eidolons.name: Payload
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Bounce Attack
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate to attack an enemy, deals additional Quantum DMG equal to 20% of Silver Wolf's ATK for every debuff on that enemy. This can trigger up to 5 times against each target during each Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Brute Force Attack
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Overlay Network
eidolons.description: For every debuff an enemy has, Silver Wolf's DMG dealt to that enemy increases by 20%, up to a maximum increase of 100%.
